transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-air lock meeting started. We've got the finale going live Saturday at 9 PM Eastern, and we need to finalize the voting package today so all teams can document it before transmission. We have standards, platform production, rights, and data protection represented here. Before I make the final call on the voting package, I want to hear from each of you — are there any issues or concerns with the current draft? Right now it's SMS and online portal voting, open to our broadcast audience. Let's go around the room.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something from the standards side. After the draft voting rules were circulated, I issued the network's current standards memo, which sets binding requirements: voters must be at least 13 years old, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account, and voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. The current draft doesn't yet reflect these constraints, so we need to incorporate them before the package is finalized.

The current draft doesn't yet reflect these constraints, so we need to incorporate them before the package is finalized."}

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue from platform production. I completed the platform certification test this morning, and the SMS integration failed certification — it is not approved for use. The web portal did pass certification, but the approved portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. So as it stands, SMS voting cannot go forward on Saturday, and any finalized package needs to reflect portal-only voting with the account verification requirement.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue with the current voting interface draft. I obtained the finalist label's written approval today, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but may not use any finalist performance audio or video. The current draft interface still contains performance clips, so those need to be removed before the package is finalized, or we won't have clearance for Saturday.
transcript.speaker: A4

The current draft interface still contains performance clips, so those need to be removed before the package is finalized, or we won't have clearance for Saturday."}

transcript.text: I need to flag a data protection issue with the current draft. I completed the privacy review with the voting vendor this week, and it sets two binding requirements: participation must be limited to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada, and voter identifiers must be deleted within 30 days. The current draft still describes worldwide participation and has no deletion step, so both of these need to be corrected before the package is finalized.
